title: Dakera Helm Chart Values
description: Configuration values for the Dakera AI agent memory platform Helm chart

rootApiKey.description: Root API key — REQUIRED, here or in existingSecret. The chart stores it in <release>-secrets

existingSecret.description: A Secret you manage, used instead of <release>-secrets: DAKERA_ROOT_API_KEY and, with the built-in MinIO, MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Not with rootApiKey

s3Endpoint.description: Custom S3 endpoint (for MinIO or external providers)

l1CacheSize.description: DAKERA_L1_CACHE_SIZE: the tiered-storage hot-tier budget. A unit suffix (1GB, 512MB) is bytes; a bare number below 10 million is a vector count

dataRoot.description: Data root (DAKERA_STORAGE_PATH); every local path derives from it and the persistence volume is mounted here

tiered.description: DAKERA_TIERED: the tiered embedding engine (not tiered storage). "1" / true on, "0" / false off

hotToWarmSecs.description: Seconds before hot memory moves to warm tier

warmToColdSecs.description: Seconds before warm memory moves to cold tier

maxBodySize.description: Maximum HTTP body size in bytes

rustLog.description: Rust log level (e.g. info, debug, warn)

sessionIdleTimeoutSecs.description: DAKERA_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS (server 0.12.2): a session with no activity for this many seconds is ended by the server. Empty = the server default, 14400 (4 h); 0 = the server ends no session that did not set its own timeout; at most 2592000 (larger values are clamped)

maxMemoryContentBytes.description: DAKERA_MAX_MEMORY_CONTENT_BYTES (server 0.12.2): the longest memory content in UTF-8 bytes. Empty = the server default, 100000; an integer > 0 (0 refuses the boot)

vectorCacheBytes.description: DAKERA_VECTOR_CACHE_BYTES (server 0.12.2): the in-process L1 vector cache, a byte size (256MB, 1GB, or a bare number of bytes). Empty = the server default, 128MB. Not l1CacheSize (the tiered-storage hot tier)

rocksdbRecordFormat.description: DAKERA_ROCKSDB_RECORD_FORMAT (server 0.12.2): how the RocksDB hot tier writes new records, binary (the server default) or json; both are always read. Empty = the server default

httpHeaderReadTimeoutSecs.description: DAKERA_HTTP_HEADER_READ_TIMEOUT_SECS (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): seconds a client has to send a complete HTTP/1 request head on the REST port; an idle keep-alive connection is closed after it. Empty = the server default, 30; 1 to 86400. Keep a proxy's upstream idle timeout below it

neighborhoodMode.description: DAKERA_NEIGHBORHOOD_MODE (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): default neighbourhood mode of a recall. Empty = the server default, inline

neighborhoodEventTime.description: DAKERA_NEIGHBORHOOD_EVENT_TIME (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): neighbourhood window on event time. Empty = off

recallRankDepth.description: DAKERA_RECALL_RANK_DEPTH (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): ranking depth floor, 1 to 1000. Empty = the server default, 10

recallCollapseDerived.description: DAKERA_RECALL_COLLAPSE_DERIVED (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): one result per source memory. Empty = off

recallExcludeSummaries.description: DAKERA_RECALL_EXCLUDE_SUMMARIES (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): session summaries left out unless a request sets include_summaries. Empty = off

recallSessionCap.description: DAKERA_RECALL_SESSION_CAP (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): at most N results of one session in the head of list recalls. Empty = the server default, 0 (no cap)

sentenceDecomp.description: DAKERA_SENTENCE_DECOMP (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): false / 0 = no sentence sub-memories on any write path. Empty = on

supersedesEventTime.description: DAKERA_SUPERSEDES_EVENT_TIME (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): false / 0 = Supersedes edges by created_at only. Empty = on (event dates)

maxConnections.description: DAKERA_MAX_CONNECTIONS (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): most open REST connections, 1 to 1000000. Empty = the server default, 10000

shutdownDrainSecs.description: DAKERA_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECS (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): longest REST drain at shutdown, 0 to 3600. Empty = the server default, 8. 15 + it + 5 must fit in dakera.terminationGracePeriodSeconds

allowedHosts.description: DAKERA_ALLOWED_HOSTS (server 0.12.3; an image up to 0.12.2 lists it as an unknown variable): read only with authEnabled false; dotted Host names accepted besides localhost, IPs and single-label names (comma separated, * = any). Others get 421

documents.description: Document import settings (server 0.12.3), each rendered only when set

enabled.description: DAKERA_DOCUMENTS (server 0.12.3): the document routes. Empty = on

maxBytes.description: DAKERA_DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES (server 0.12.3): largest source document in bytes. Empty = 26214400 (25 MiB)

maxTextBytes.description: DAKERA_DOCUMENT_MAX_TEXT_BYTES (server 0.12.3): most extracted text in bytes. Empty = 20971520

maxChunks.description: DAKERA_DOCUMENT_MAX_CHUNKS (server 0.12.3): most chunks per document. Empty = 5000

chunkTokens.description: DAKERA_DOCUMENT_CHUNK_TOKENS (server 0.12.3): default chunk budget, 32 to 8192. Empty = 400

extractTimeoutSecs.description: DAKERA_DOCUMENT_EXTRACT_TIMEOUT_SECS (server 0.12.3): wall clock of one PDF / DOCX extraction. Empty = 60

extractMemoryMb.description: DAKERA_DOCUMENT_EXTRACT_MEMORY_MB (server 0.12.3): address space of one extraction child, MB. Empty = 1024. The memory limit must hold extractConcurrency x this on top of the server

cluster.description: Cluster mode secret (DAKERA_CLUSTER_SECRET, at least 16 characters, identical on every node; required in cluster mode from server 0.12.1)

secret.description: Chart-managed secret value, stored in <release>-secrets: empty, or at least 16 characters

name.description: Name of a Secret you manage

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the Dakera container (Kubernetes EnvVar list)

pull.description: Models pulled by an init container (dakera models pull); `configured` = the configured environment

features.description: v0.12 features, all off by default (see values.yaml and the README, "Features in v0.12.0")

prePull.description: Pull the models the enabled features load in an init container (dakera models pull configured)

persistModelCache.description: Keep the model cache on a PVC while a feature that needs models is enabled

multilingual.description: bge-m3, per-language full-text, CJK bigrams, multilingual query routing

resources.description: Used instead of dakera.resources while the feature is on

vision.description: Image / page indexing and visual recall (a dedicated store)

resources.description: Used instead of dakera.resources while the feature is on

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Read-only root filesystem for the server container, its init container and the rollback Job (default true: the data root, the model cache and /tmp are volumes)

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period of the server pod: at least 15 (media jobs) + shutdownDrainSecs (8 by default) + 5

timeoutSeconds.description: timeoutSeconds of the server's startup, liveness and readiness probes

persistence.description: Persistent volume for the data root

storageClass.description: StorageClass name — empty uses cluster default

rollback.description: Optional one-off Job that runs `dakera downgrade` (rollback to v0.11.108)

image.description: Image for the Job; default: the server image

sessionTtlHours.description: DAKERA_SESSION_TTL_HOURS; empty uses the dashboard default (12)

trustedProxies.description: DAKERA_TRUSTED_PROXIES (dashboard 0.5.2): addresses / CIDRs of the reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For names the client, comma or space separated. Empty: the connecting peer is the client

securityContext.description: Container securityContext of the dashboard (default for 0.5.2: uid/gid 10001, read-only root with a /tmp emptyDir, no capability). An image up to 0.5.1 needs root, a writable root and CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, SETGID, SETUID

mcp.description: Dakera MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configuration

minio.description: Built-in MinIO S3-compatible storage. Set enabled: false to use external S3.

enabled.description: Enable built-in MinIO. Disable to use external S3.

rootPassword.description: MinIO root password — REQUIRED when minio.enabled is true (in the chart's Secret with rootApiKey, else in your Secret)

enabled.description: NetworkPolicy: only this release's Dakera pods (and additionalFrom) reach MinIO

additionalFrom.description: More NetworkPolicyPeer entries allowed to reach MinIO (ports api and console)

ingress.description: Kubernetes Ingress configuration for external access

apiHost.description: Hostname for the Dakera API (e.g. api.dakera.yourdomain.com)

enabled.description: Enable monitoring components (no templates: use prometheusRule / grafanaDashboard below)

prometheusRule.description: The server's v0.12 alert rules as a Prometheus Operator PrometheusRule

grafanaDashboard.description: The server's v0.12 dashboard as a ConfigMap for Grafana's dashboard sidecar

adminPassword.description: Grafana admin password — auto-generated if empty

global.description: Global settings applied across all components

imagePullSecrets.description: List of image pull secrets for private registries
